author: Inside Edition
description: CBS News and Paramount Plus look back on the terror attacks with the primetime special "9/11: We Remember" hosted by Tony Dukoupil. It will feature the first "60 Minutes" story about 9/11 as reported by the late Ed Bradley. On NBC, "Face Ground Zero: A Dateline Special" will air with never-before-seen-footage from 9/11. On ABC, "9/11 Tribute in Light" will feature performances by country singer Lainey Wilson. PBS will commemorate 9/11 with a special performance by the Metropolitan Opera.
title: Multiple TV Networks Will Air Stories Marking 25th Anniversary Of 9/11

author: Inside Edition
description: After the planes hit the twin towers on September 11, 2001, it took a little less than two hours for the skyscrapers to collapse. During those agonizing minutes, people trapped high up in their offices knew something was seriously wrong. Many made their last calls home. Now, a quarter of a century later, recordings of those victims' goodbyes to their loved ones remain heart-wrenching.
title: Final Calls From 9/11 Victims Are Still Heart-Wrenching

author: Inside Edition
description: It may be hard to believe, but over 30% of Americans were born after the 9/11 attacks. For many families, it's becoming more important to tell the stories of those lost to ensure they aren't forgotten. Some relatives are sharing home movies of their loved ones on social media, to keep the memories of their loved ones alive. Inside Edition's Alison Hall reports on this touching social media trend.
title: Loved Ones Are Sharing Home Movies Of Those Lost On 9/11 On Social Media

author: Inside Edition
description: Before terror struck on September 11, 2001, it was an exceptionally quiet morning in New York City, with commuters and tourists enjoying a sunny, blue sky. Then, at 8:46 AM, the first plane hit the North tower of the World Trade Center, and the world would never be the same. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano has a minute-by-minute account of how a seemingly perfect day became synonymous with terror.
title: Minute-By-Minute Account Of The 9/11 Attacks

author: Inside Edition
description: What could be the holdup on this California highway? It turned out to be a cat that probably wished it was stuck up in a tree when it found itself astray on a busy Sacramento freeway. Since no ladder was needed to help it, the California Highway Patrol was called in for the rescue. An officer stopped traffic, parking across the lanes of the roadway. He then put on his gloves and made quite the easy save. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Highway Patrol Rescues Scared Kitten From Busy California Road

author: Inside Edition
description: Twenty-five years have passed since the 9/11 attacks, and today a moving ceremony was held at the 9/11 Memorial in lower Manhattan. Several former presidents paid their respects in New York, while President Trump attended the Pentagon memorial remembrance ceremony. It was a day many Americans stopped to remember the events that changed their worlds forever. Nearly 3,000 people lost their lives in what's considered the deadliest terror attack in history.
title: Moving Ceremony Marks 25th Anniversary Of 9/11 Attacks

author: Inside Edition
description: A suspect, fleeing police, jumped into the driver's seat of one of their patrol cars and took off. Police in Dayton, Ohio, say the suspect was seen driving erratically through an active crash investigation scene. Officers decided to pursue the vehicle, which did not stop for police sirens and lights. The runaway vehicle eventually crashed after being struck by a police car in a PIT maneuver. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Suspect Takes Police Cruiser, Crashes Into House: Cops
